subject: math

objective.text: Round numbers to the nearest thousand using a vertical number line.

explanations.title: Find the two thousands
explanations.text: To round to the nearest thousand, find the thousand below the number. Then find the thousand above it. These are the endpoints.

explanations.title: Halfway point
explanations.text: The halfway point is 500 more than the lower thousand. 4,500 is halfway between 4,000 and 5,000.

explanations.title: Nearer endpoint
explanations.text: If a number is below the halfway point, it rounds down. If it is above the halfway point, it rounds up.

explanations.title: Halfway rounds up
explanations.text: If a number is exactly halfway, we round up. 14,500 rounded to the nearest thousand is 15,000.

explanations.title: Thousands in a number
explanations.text: Say how many thousands are in the number. One more thousand gives the upper endpoint.

examples.title: Round 4,100 and 4,700
examples.text: 4,100 is nearer to 4,000, so it rounds to 4,000. 4,700 is nearer to 5,000, so it rounds to 5,000.

examples.title: Midpoint of 31,000 and 32,000
examples.text: 31,000 is 310 hundreds and 32,000 is 320 hundreds. The midpoint is 315 hundreds, or 31,500.
